summary.headline: UN science panel warns AI-agent safeguards are unravelling
summary.body: The UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI issued its first thematic brief, warning that safeguards for capable AI agents are not keeping pace and urging precaution on loss-of-control risk. Coming from a top-credibility source, it weakened Alignment & Control, which lifts Conquerors and Zookeeper and pulls down the bright endings that need safe AI. It also counted as a small step toward Global Coordination. Capability kept climbing: OpenAI said an internal model resolved more than 100 additional open math problems, and Xiaomi open-sourced a 1-trillion-parameter model under an MIT licence, spreading power more widely. Zookeeper moved ahead of Benevolent Dictator. Horizon Balance dropped to -9.28.
summary.movers_note: Conquerors +0.8 (UN brief +0.69, OpenAI math +0.10), Protector God -0.6 (UN brief -0.69, partly offset by OpenAI math +0.10) and Benevolent Dictator -0.6 (UN brief -0.50, Xiaomi -0.07).

events.title: OpenAI says internal model resolved 100+ open math problems; forms IAS advisory group
events.summary: OpenAI said an internal model resolved more than 100 additional open problems and set up a nine-member Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI at Princeton's IAS to assess results.
events.reason: Claimed research-level capability jump; mostly company claim, advisory group confirmed by Terence Tao's blog.

events.title: Xiaomi open-sources 1T-parameter MiMo-V2.6-Pro under MIT license
events.summary: Xiaomi released weights, code and a technical report for MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL, a 1.02T-parameter MoE that scored 46 on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index, matching xAI's Grok 4.7.
events.reason: Strong open-weights release from China spreads capability.

events.title: UN scientific panel warns safeguards for AI agents are unravelling
events.summary: The UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI issued its first thematic brief, warning that safeguards for capable AI agents are not keeping pace and invoking a precautionary approach to loss-of-control risk.
events.reason: First output of UN scientific panel; authoritative global warning on control risk.
